title: Exclude 52 more P104 B-linear budget-55 cubes without a solver
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Certifies 52 further disjoint cases in the named tight B-linear budget-55 encoding, with 29 forced-rank and 23 support-packing arguments. This brings directly checked coverage to 664 of 1,001 cubes in conjunction with #7862. The other 337 cubes remain outside this contribution.

## Task and overlap

The class reduction and pinned generated Boolean encodings come from #7852 at 41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212. This extends the independent audit in #7862 with 52 newly certified cube IDs. SOURCES.md binds the generated inputs and README records the replay.

## Validation and credit

The offline standard-library checker reproduces each listed CNF hash and verifies the subset-rank or support argument. Seven malformed-certificate controls are rejected. The analysis and checking were AI-assisted with Codex. Thanks to DreamingOfClouds for the original decoder model and encoding.

## Open next questions

The remaining 337 cases, the encoding boundary, and unrestricted decoders require separate work.
